title: Teardown
intro: After the event: every piece of gear back, every switch config archived, the event's data exported, and the team's own steps.
gearBack: Every piece of gear is checked in.
openGear: Check gear in on the gear page
configsHelp: Tick each switch once its config is saved (downloaded or pushed to NetBox).
noSwitches: No switch is placed on the floor plan.
exportHelp: One zip: a backup of the floor plan and settings, the event report as PDF, the incidents, the gear history and the handovers.
adminOnly: An admin downloads the export, because it holds a backup.
